title: Characteristic Function Expansion at Zero
statement: Let $X$ be a real random variable on a probability space, measurable up to a null set, with finite second moment, mean zero, and second moment $q$. Then, as $t\to0$, its characteristic function satisfies $\mathbb{E}[e^{itX}]=1-qt^2/2+o(t^2)$.
hypotheses_covered: The underlying measure is a probability measure
